metadata.title: Performance Dependence on Initial Free-End Levitation of a Magnetically Levitated Piezoelectric Vibration Energy Harvester With a Composite Cantilever Beam

configuration.quote: magnetically levitated piezoelectric vibration energy harvester (PVEH) with a composite cantilever beam

proof_mass.quote: high-stiffness lead zirconate titanate beam with a proof mass and a flexible brass beam with a tip mass

length_mm.quote: commercial piezoelectric plate with the size of 45 x 39 x 0.5 mm^3 was adopted as the primary beam

width_mm.quote: commercial piezoelectric plate with the size of 45 x 39 x 0.5 mm^3 was adopted as the primary beam

thickness_mm.quote: commercial piezoelectric plate with the size of 45 x 39 x 0.5 mm^3 was adopted as the primary beam

substrate_thickness_um.quote: The thicknesses of PZT plate and substrate plate were 0.3 mm and 0.2 mm, respectively

piezo_thickness_um.quote: The thicknesses of PZT plate and substrate plate were 0.3 mm and 0.2 mm, respectively

tip_mass_g.quote: The total tip mass (including small metal plates on the tip, two permanent magnets and an additional fixture that held the magnets) of the brass beam was 19.66 g

type.quote: Vibration energy harvesting by using piezoelectric materials

displacement_mm.quote: vibration excitation was held constant at a displacement amplitude of 0.5 mm

motion_source.quote: The fabricated prototype was mounted on an electrodynamic vibration generator

resonant_frequency_Hz.quote: second resonance frequency decreased from 54 to 51 Hz

output_power_W.quote: peak power at the second resonance frequency was increased from 904.5 to 2735.6 uW
